subject: mom's birthday
body: mom's birthday is sunday. she needs a new jacket. can you chip in 40 for one? or if that marketplace of yours is real, grab one there and i'll cover my half.

outcomes.when: the player agrees to chip in money for the gift
the player will buy the jacket themselves on their marketplace
outcomes.reply: legend. i'll send you my half on her birthday.

outcomes.when: the player makes an excuse or says they can't help
outcomes.reply: ok. i'll tell her you were busy.

hints: Chip in 40, buy one yourself, or bow out.
